# Feature Request

## Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the feature or improvement.

---

## Problem Statement

Describe the problem or limitation you are experiencing.

---

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you would like this feature to work.

---

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

---

## Benefits

Explain how this feature would improve FinTrack AI or benefit users.

---

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, references, or any other relevant information.

---

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues before submitting this request.
- [ ] This is a feature request, not a bug report.
- [ ] I have clearly described the problem and proposed solution.
- [ ] I have included any relevant context or examples.
